//: Conformance script for the java-junit adapter on the MAVEN fixture (task P3-04). The runner (run.ts) spawns the manifest's invocation strings VERBATIM from `cwd` (= maven-basic, the project under test), so this certifies exactly what core's adapter client spawns. `resolveBin` binds the manifest bin name to `node <dist/cli.js>` — the same name→path resolution core does at init, and PATH-independent under CI's `npm ci` (which precedes the build). The adapter drives Maven from `cwd` and finds its bundled resolve-helper jar package-relative, so no env is needed. `timeoutMs` is generous: each spawned case runs a real (cold) `mvn` invocation; the malformed-stdin universal check adds none (stdin is rejected before any build). package.files are the current unpackaged bytes (dist wrapper + manifest + helper jar); rebuild-twice byte-determinism and the pinned single-file packaging are P3-06's bar, not this runner's.
name: java-junit-maven
